zakatClaimEvidence: MCA provides Zakah funds to Muslim individuals/families in need. MCA's core social service is the collection of Zakat and Sadaqah funds to support people in need of additional support such as those who may be unemployed, homeless, or refugees. The Zakah and Relief committee reports to the MCA Treasurer and is chartered to facilitate the distribution of Zakah and Sadaqa monies in accordance with the principles of Sharia and in compliance with the Federal and State guidelines and laws. All individuals applying for Zakah or Sadaqa are required to complete and submit a Zakah Application. They also explicitly state 'Donate Sadaqah & Zakaat Here' on their donation page. (Source: https://www.1degree.org/opp/get-financial-assistance-for-the-muslim-community-association-santa-clara-ca)
